newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan tax rise impact limited to Apr-June qtr--EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan tax rise impact limited to Apr-June qtr--EPA.

text.p: The impact of the rise in the national consumption tax on the Japanese economy is likely to be confined to the April to June quarter, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) vice minister Shimpei Nukaya said on Friday.

He said demand for high-priced goods had fallen in reaction to heightened demand at the end of March prior to the tax increase, but added: "Overall, (the decrease in demand) is within expectations and is likely to be confined to the April to June period."
Nukaya also said the situation in the labour market was gradually recovering although the unemployment rate still remained at a high level.
The government announced earlier on Friday that the jobless rate rose to 3.3 percent in fiscal 1996/97, ended March 31, up from 3.2 percent the year before.
The vice minister said the government was unlikely to alter its assessment of the economy in its forthcoming monthly economic report for May.
"The economy is continuing its gradual recovery and there's no need to change that judgment," Nukaya said.
